title: NotebookLM for Windows
subtitle: Native desktop wrapper · 2,000+ downloads
description: Power users of NotebookLM lose context every time they leave the browser. I shipped an Electron-based desktop wrapper with session persistence, system-level shortcuts, and native notifications for long-running audio generation tasks. The product converts a research-heavy web app into a persistent, OS-integrated workspace. Crossed 2,000 downloads organically.

title: cue
subtitle: Zero-dependency dev environment CLI
description: A zero-dependency, ultra-lightweight CLI utility. Replaces the need to memorise OS-specific package-manager syntax, manually handle install lock conflicts, or babysit downloads over flaky networks. Provisions developer environment stacks and integrates Claude Code with local Ollama via LiteLLM proxy.

title: Gyanesh on Product
subtitle: 48 editions · 1000+ subscribers
description: Weekly newsletter on product, AI, behavioural economics, and consumer behaviour. Published on LinkedIn, mirrored in-site. Covers everything from validation gaps to behavioural pricing to building AI features that actually ship.

title: Pegasus Spyware: Attack System Artemis
subtitle: IEEE ICECAA · Aug 2023
description: Co-authored study examining the technical intricacies of Pegasus spyware. Explores propagation methods, zero-day vulnerability exploitation, and HTTPS command-and-control channels. Reveals the elusive nature of Pegasus and the minimal traces it leaves on infected systems.

title: NFT Analytical Modelling on Blockchain Data
subtitle: IEEE ICNWC · May 2023
description: ETL pipelines transforming EVM-node data into a centralized database for analytical modelling. Recommends potential uprising high-value NFTs via SparkSQL visualization and a cross-platform Flutter front-end.

title: Dynamic Network Architecture for IoT
subtitle: IEEE ICICCS · Dec 2022
description: Proposed an architecture for connecting 200+ IoT devices seamlessly without bandwidth degradation. Uses the Arduino Uno WiFi REV2 as a bridge between WiFi and Zigbee communication.
